description: This file contains a test class `KpiServiceTest` for the `KpiService` component of the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It includes setup, multiple unit tests for saving KPIs, handling default KPIs, and exception scenarios.

classes.name: KpiServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the functionality of the `KpiService`. It tests methods like `saveKpi`, default KPI handling and exception management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of `KpiService` and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetKpiDao
methods.description: Verifies that `getKpiDao` returns an instance of `KpiDao`.

methods.name: testSaveKpi
methods.description: Tests saving a new KPI object and expects it to return an instance of `Kpi`.

methods.name: testSaveKpiWithDefaultTrue
methods.description: Tests saving a KPI marked as default, ensuring default KPI behavior and uniqueness.

methods.name: testSaveKpiWithDefaultTrue2
methods.description: Verifies that saving a KPI with `defaultKpi` set to true unsets the previously default KPI.

methods.name: testKpiServiceExceptionForSaveKpi
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to save a KPI with invalid ratings throws a `KpiServiceException`.

methods.name: testTransactionExceptionForSaveKpi
methods.description: Tests that a transaction exception is thrown when the DAO layer throws a generic exception during KPI save.
